title: tier-gate: tiered skill required before Agent dispatch
desc: Blocks Agent dispatch when a recently-edited skill has a tier score below 60. Forces 3-tier splitting before delegating.
steps: SAFETY: Fires before Agent dispatch when the last skill you edited has a tier score below 60/100. A low-score skill is a monolithic blob -- it forces the delegated agent to read many steps to find one relevant paragraph, wasting tokens and increasing mis-application risk.

SOLUTION: Split the low-score skill into 3-tier form: T1 core skill + T2 -howto + T3 -ref. Run 'wkappbot skill read skill-migration-3tier' for the split procedure. After splitting, the tier score rises and the gate clears.

PREVENTION: Write skills in 3-tier form from the start. T1 = core safety/solution/prevention (5-8 steps). T2 = howto with examples. T3 = edge cases and history. Each tier should be independently readable in under 30 seconds.
author: claude
